measured_fact: Nov/Dec margin ~29-30% vs 46.5% baseline every year 2021-2025; volume spikes 50-85%
business_meaning: Annual promotional event drives volume at large margin cost
opportunity_risk: Absolute profit still rises in peak months; risk of customer discount-conditioning
recommended_action: Model break-even; test tiered loyalty-member early-access at smaller discount to recover 3-5 margin points

measured_fact: July margin ~37-38% every year; volume near normal (1,650-1,737 orders)
business_meaning: Mid-year discount applied without compensating volume uplift
opportunity_risk: Margin cost without equivalent volume benefit — worse ROI than holiday sale
recommended_action: Audit July discount policy; replace blanket markdown with targeted bundle deals or loyalty multipliers

measured_fact: Mobile App 40.1% + Website 34.9% = 75% of orders; margins flat ~41.4% across all channels
business_meaning: Revenue concentrated in two channels with no margin incentive to diversify
opportunity_risk: Platform dependency risk; Marketplace and Social Media underdeveloped as contingency
recommended_action: Set target to grow Marketplace + Social Media to 20% combined share via promotional investment

measured_fact: 23.5% of delivered orders delayed; actual delivery avg 4.56 days vs 4.30 estimated; gap consistent across all shipping methods
business_meaning: Estimation model is systematically optimistic by ~0.3 days regardless of tier
opportunity_risk: Contributes to mid-range satisfaction (3.68/5); increases return risk
recommended_action: Add 0.5-day buffer to customer-facing delivery estimates at zero operational cost; audit warehouse throughput in Nov/Dec

measured_fact: Mean rating 3.68; distribution peaks 3.6-3.8; only 8.1% rate >= 4.5; VIP highest (3.83), Consumer/Business lowest (3.63)
business_meaning: Customers satisfied but not delighted; large neutral cohort has weak loyalty signal
opportunity_risk: Below industry benchmark ~4.2-4.5; small operational improvements could shift many 3.5 to 4.0+
recommended_action: Cross-reference Neutral orders with delayed delivery; run loyalty-point re-engagement nudge for 3.0-3.5 rated customers

finding: Return rate 7.69% uniform across channels and regions
measured_fact: Return rate 7.69%; range 7.19-7.99% across regions and channels; return_reason column unpopulated
business_meaning: Product-level driver (not channel/geography); root-cause analysis currently impossible
opportunity_risk: ~1,200 orders/year recovered per 1pp reduction; reverse logistics cost not in dataset
recommended_action: Fix return_reason data capture pipeline; improve product descriptions for high-volume SKUs

measured_fact: 14.36M points earned, 7.17M redeemed (49.9%); avg 126.5 earned / 63.2 redeemed per order
business_meaning: Half of earned loyalty value unredeemed; low redemption weakens repeat-purchase motivation
opportunity_risk: Low-cost re-engagement lever; points expiry campaign can pull forward repeat purchases
recommended_action: Run points-expiry reminder campaign for high-balance low-activity customers

measured_fact: 1,229 Completed orders with negative profit; worst margin -59.55%; total negative profit not isolated
business_meaning: Discount engine has no floor — some orders clear below product cost
opportunity_risk: Small share but indicative of pricing rule gap; inflates discount line
recommended_action: Introduce floor-price rule: block checkout if computed profit after all adjustments is negative
